title: Gate B: the inference gateway, its budget, its context binding and its second reading
note: Every mutation here would let a model call do something the gateway exists to stop: spend without authority, spend past a budget, answer under stale rules, leak a credential, or turn into a proposal that is not what the model said. The second reader's mutations check that it would notice each of those independently.

mutations.name: IG1_anyone_may_grant_spending_on_replay
mutations.rationale: a budget appended by any actor would be spending authority on every load

mutations.name: IG2_anyone_may_publish_a_budget
mutations.rationale: an agent could grant itself money to spend

mutations.name: IG3_any_caller_may_spend
mutations.rationale: a budget for one researcher would pay for anybody's calls

mutations.name: IG4_any_model_may_be_called
mutations.rationale: a budget priced for one model would pay for another at a price nobody set

mutations.name: IG5_per_request_bounds_ignored
mutations.rationale: one request could ask for far more output, time or attempts than any request may

mutations.name: IG7_stale_policy_accepted

mutations.name: IG8_totals_check_only_what_is_held
mutations.rationale: the call that crosses the budget would be granted, so the budget is a floor on overspending rather than a ceiling

mutations.name: IG9_rate_window_off_by_one
mutations.rationale: one more call per window than the budget allows

mutations.name: IG10_attempt_bound_not_enforced_by_the_gate
mutations.rationale: only the caller's own loop would bound retries; a caller that loops again spends again
